appearances.snippet: He's an absolute loser. We only wanted him when he was willing to sacrifice his family. And then, of course, Mark Levin again is going to say, now the DOJ should open a criminal investigation to determine if Kent leaked any classified information.

verification.notes: Owens read this as a Mark Levin post, but live searches did not locate the original post or a reliable independent reproduction. The proposition is also a normative recommendation rather than a factual result. The episode transcript confirms the rebroadcast only, so original-source verification remains inconclusive.

records.text: Mark Levin's allies want Tucker Carlson imprisoned, and Carlson has revealed that the CIA has been spying on him.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And further to that point, Trump (Donald J. Trump) has apparently allowed Mark Levin's special class of psychos to go after Tucker Carlson. ... They want to imprison him. They are explicit in that demand. And he has just revealed that the CIA has been spying on him.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 1:03 preserves Owens's composite accusation. Current sources document pro-Levin/pro-war figures such as Laura Loomer demanding FARA action and jail for Carlson, and document Carlson publicly alleging that the CIA read his texts and prepared a DOJ referral. However, no public CIA or DOJ confirmation establishes that the government actually spied on him or prepared that referral. The rhetoric is documented; the asserted agency conduct remains unconfirmed.

records.text: Was Joe Kent about to be fired but resigned first, and was he one of the administration's leakers?
records.speaker: Mark Levin

appearances.snippet: Okay. Next up, we have Mark Levin, a resident psycho. I wonder if this guy Joe Kent was about to be fired. ... but quickly resigned first. That's how these things typically work. He's part of the radical isolationist woke right cabal. ... I wonder if he was one of the leakers inside of the administration just asking questions.

verification.notes: Levin phrased both propositions as questions. Later reporting says an FBI leak investigation predated Kent's resignation and that he had been iced out, providing some basis for the questions. Whether he actually leaked classified information or was definitively about to be fired remains unresolved, so the insinuation is only partially supported.

sources.relevance: Reports a preexisting investigation and claims Kent was iced out, while noting guilt was unresolved.

records.text: Tucker Carlson is a “Nazi promoter” and “the modern-day David Duke.”
records.speaker: Mark Levin

appearances.snippet: "You're a Nazi promoter." ... "You're the modern-day David Duke."

verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim. In the embedded Mark Levin Show clip, Levin says Carlson invited him to a Turning Point event debate and reads his reply verbatim: “You’re a Nazi promoter” and “You’re the modern-day David Duke.” The official program page identifies the broadcast, and independent reporting reproduces the same exchange. This verifies Levin’s utterance, not the truth of the insults.

sources.title: November 7th, 2025 | The Mark Levin Show

sources.title: “You’re a Nazi Promoter” Mark Levin Skewers Tucker Carlson in Fiery Text Exchange Over Turning Point USA Debate
sources.relevance: Independent reporting reproduces both phrases and explains that they were Levin’s response to Carlson’s Turning Point USA debate invitation.

records.text: Mark Levin argued that the United States should arm Iranian opposition groups.
records.speaker: Mark Levin

appearances.snippet: He claimed that the Iranian resistance has hidden crude weaponry and tools throughout the country, bricks, rocks, wooden clubs, chairs and tires used to block roads, waiting for the day that the people once again take to the streets. ... Well, they're not going to come out armed if we don't arm them. Now let's arm them!

verification.notes: The published August 4, 2026 transcript records Levin repeatedly urging that Iranian opposition demonstrators be armed, culminating in 'Now let's arm them' and 'Arm them.' This directly verifies the attributed policy argument.

sources.title: Mark Levin: Why Will We Not Arm Iranian Protesters?
sources.relevance: Publishes video and transcript of Levin's explicit call to arm Iranian opposition groups.

records.text: Mark Levin predicted that if Iranian opposition groups received the weapons they needed, they would overthrow Iran's government.
records.speaker: Mark Levin

appearances.snippet: There's clearly not enough. There's clearly not what they need. If we give them what they need, they will overthrow this government.

verification.notes: A current transcript of Mark Levin's August 4, 2026 program records him saying that Iranian opposition groups lacked sufficient weapons and that if the United States gave them what they needed, they would overthrow the government. This verifies the attributed conditional prediction, not its future fulfillment.

sources.title: Mark Levin: Why Will We Not Arm Iranian Protesters?
